function: Excluded for system: over-the-air aggregation in semi-asynchronous federated learning (area 7) on a single-antenna OFDM link with no RIS (p. 5)
notes: Excluded for system (code 6). p. 5: "In our model, we consider OFDM-based SISO transmission." The clients and the parameter server have one antenna each and no RIS appears in the model (pp. 5-6, 11); MIMO beamforming is mentioned only as related work (p. 2). The earlier checks pass: the learned element is the model trained across the clients (MLP on MNIST, VGG11 on CIFAR-10, p. 12), and the paper solves the AirComp aggregation itself (optimal power control, encoder and decoder, aggregation weights by a convex QP, pp. 9-11), which is area 7.
